verdict.rationale: HMRC's own employer-registration page says you can check when to expect your registration letter. That is a first-party, service-published timing signal for one transaction type, but it is a single thin mention with no published processing-time figures and no evidence it covers other transaction types or is kept current. Missing for 10: published current processing-time figures, coverage across transaction types (VAT, Corporation Tax, MTD sign-up), evidence the data is kept up to date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: You can check when to expect your letter from HMRC about your registration.
